title: AMOS-Federation Smoke Test
description: Smoke test schema for the tests domain. Defines a lightweight test result structure used to verify each of the 12 domains has a working nucleus. Smoke tests are fast, non-exhaustive checks.

test_id.description: Unique identifier for the smoke test run.

domain.description: Domain the smoke test covers (one of the 12 AMOS-Federation domains).

test_name.description: Human-readable name of the smoke test.

message.description: Summary message describing the result or failure reason.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the test in milliseconds.

timestamp.description: When the smoke test was executed.

assertions.description: Individual assertions evaluated by the smoke test.

actual.description: Actual value observed for the assertion.
